entities.summary: Héctor Luis Lucas Peña Gómez was a Cuban Roman Catholic prelate. He was an auxiliary bishop of Santiago de Cuba (1970–1979) and diocesan bishop of Holguín (1979–2005).

entities.summary: Héctor Luis Lucas Peña Gómez was a Cuban Roman Catholic prelate. He was an auxiliary bishop of Santiago de Cuba (1970–1979) and diocesan bishop of Holguín (1979–2005).
